lines.text: Dana planned Utah in November and packed for the desert.
The rim sits at eight thousand feet,
and after snow the trails can pack down into ice.
Her sneakers slid on the first switchback.
Here's the fix. Pack warm layers and traction that straps over your boots.
Check the park alerts for closed trails that morning.
Now she walks the hoodoos under snow, steady.
Save this before your Utah trip.
